links.comparator_used: Original Society of Pediatric Dermatology (SPD) Spanish patient brochures
links.outcome: Readability of Spanish patient education materials across seven readability measures
links.effect: Both ChatGPT 4.0 and Google Gemini, prompted for a 6th grade level, produced significantly improved readability scores compared with the SPD handouts (no numeric values in the abstract)
links.quote: Our results showed that when prompted to produce material at a 6th grade level, both AI ChatBots generated significantly improved readability scores when compared to the SPD handouts.
